title: Correction to: Molecular systematics and species revision of a Neotropical genus of flightless phaneropterine katydids (Orthoptera: Tettigoniidae: Phaneropterinae)
content: In the recently published article “Molecular systematics and species revision of a Neotropical genus of flightless phaneropterine katydids (Orthoptera: Tettigoniidae: Phaneropterinae)” (https://doi.org/10.1093/zoolinnean/zlaf041) by Fianco & Melo (2025), four new species-level names were proposed. However, these names do not fulfill the mandatory provisions of the International Code of Zoological Nomenclature (ICZN, 1999), from now on referred as The Code, and must therefore be regarded as nomina nuda. In particular, the article fails to meet the requirements of Article 16.4.2 of The Code, which stipulates that for any new species-group name published after 1999, the name-bearing type (i.e., the holotype) must be explicitly fixed and the depository collection where it is housed must be clearly stated, including the name and location of the institution.
siteTitle: Zoological Journal of the Linnean Society Current Issue
